explanation: Erdős #1074: what is the relative density among primes of the Pillai primes (p dividing m! + 1 for some m with p ≢ 1 mod m)? The definition matches the site, with 23 as the first member, as the tests confirm. HasDensity relative to the primes encodes |P ∩ [1,x]|/π(x). The statement is faithful and open.
